title: The Tobago House of Assembly (Amendment) Act, 2026
text:
Legal Supplement Part A to the “Trinidad and Tobago Gazette”, Vol. 65,
No. 9, 22nd January, 2026
Second Session Thirteenth Parliament Republic of
Trinidad and Tobago
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
Act No. 1 of 2026
[L.S.]
BILL
AN ACT to amend the Tobago House of Assembly Act,
Chap. 25:03
[Assented to 21st January, 2026]
ENACTED by the Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago as
Enactment
follows:
1. This Act may be cited as the Tobago House of
Short title
Assembly (Amendment) Act, 2026.
2. In this Act, “the Act” means the Tobago House of
Interpretation
Chap. 25:03
Assembly Act.
2 No. 1 Tobago House of Assembly (Amendment) 2026
3. Section 3 of the Act is amended, in the definitions of
Section 3 amended
“Assemblyman” and “Member” by deleting the word
“Assemblyman” and substituting the words “Assembly
Member”, respectively.
4. Section 33 of the Act is amended in sub-
Section 33
amended section (1)(c) by deleting the words “, not being more
than seven,”.
5. Section 68 of the Act is amended by deleting the
Section 68 amended
word “nine” and substituting the word “twelve”.
6. The Act is amended by deleting the word
Act amended
“Assemblyman” or “Assemblymen” wherever it occurs,
and substituting in each place the words “Assembly
Member” or “Assembly Members”, respectively.
Passed in the House of Representatives this 16th day
of January, 2026.
Clerk of the House
Passed in the Senate this 20th day of January, 2026.
Clerk of the Senate
